description: This file is a Java source code defining a REST controller for managing insurance claims. It provides endpoints for submitting claims, updating claim status, retrieving claims by reference, and listing claims for a customer, with role-based access control.

classes.name: ClaimController
classes.description: REST controller class providing endpoints for creating, updating, and retrieving claims with security and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a new claim, optionally logging an attachment URL.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the status of an existing claim, recording the change.

methods.name: byReference
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a claim by its unique reference.

methods.name: forCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all claims associated with a specific customer.
